cases.title: G4 Graduate ML LongCat2: Tool-Rich Learning Cycle - Context 200k
cases.taskTitle: Machine Learning Graduate Research and Learning
cases.taskGoal: Act as a machine-learning graduate student. Spend the token budget on iterative learning with web research and computation, continuously consolidate knowledge into memory artifacts, and finally deliver one paper plus one literature review as milestone reports.
cases.currentObjective: Complete a machine-learning graduate learning cycle on external ML topics, then deliver academically structured outputs without drifting into this repository's implementation details.

currentContext.title: learning scope
currentContext.content: The learning topic is modern machine learning with emphasis on representation learning, optimization, generalization, and evaluation methodology. Learning outputs must be reusable and structured.

currentContext.title: process contract
currentContext.content: The process is primary: build multi-level plans, execute independent steps, and log auditable actions. Each next step can only rely on explicit artifacts from documents or memory output, not hidden context carry-over.

currentContext.title: delivery contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is enabled and required. Use web and compute evidence, then produce milestone outputs: one paper and one literature review. Append formal delivery footer headings: ## 结果, ## 证据, ## 风险, ## 已知问题.

cases.responseRequirements: Use tools and deliver a learning-process-first report in Markdown. Work-tree and plan nodes are context-hygiene tools: use them when they isolate noisy exploration, repeated work, candidate directions, or evidence handoff; do not create decomposition ceremony for short, clear work. Keep each active step focused when a step is needed, and make each action serve the current evidence goal. Tool-call rule: no empty arguments for required-parameter tools; never send empty object/array placeholders. Scope rule: treat this repository only as runtime environment, not as research object; unless explicitly required for debugging, do not analyze project source code or implementation architecture. Long-horizon stage guideline: broad exploration -> focused exploration -> experiment research -> result reflection -> paper writing, with dynamic round counts and explicit rationale when you adjust them. After broad exploration, select one core innovation point as the main line when the evidence supports that choice. Report current stage and round index when the run is in a staged long-horizon segment. File-first delivery rule: write the paper and literature review to files under tmp/graduate-deliverables/ before final answer, then report file paths and concise summary. Include Evidence/Memory Assets and Budget/Risks when they add useful context. Include milestone outputs (one paper + one literature review) as stage reports only. End with exactly: ## 结果, ## 证据, ## 风险, ## 已知问题. Output Markdown only.
cases.restartMessage: Continue the machine-learning graduate learning process report on external ML topics. Keep tool evidence and artifact handoff explicit, use staged research only where it helps quality, keep paper/review file paths under tmp/graduate-deliverables/, and end with ## 结果/## 证据/## 风险/## 已知问题.
